# Vendored front-end assets

Served by the console so it never depends on a CDN at runtime. Fetched from npm via jsDelivr on 2026-10-22.

| File | Package | License |
|---|---|---|
| `echarts.min.js` | echarts 5.6.0 | Apache-2.0 |
| `d3.min.js` | d3 7.9.0 | ISC |
| `highlight.min.js`, `hljs-sql.min.js` | @highlightjs/cdn-assets 11.11.1 | BSD-3-Clause |
| `fonts/inter-latin-wght-normal.woff2` | @fontsource-variable/inter 5.2.5 | SIL OFL 1.1 |
| `fonts/jetbrains-mono-latin-wght-normal.woff2` | @fontsource-variable/jetbrains-mono 5.2.5 | SIL OFL 1.1 |

Brand files in `../brand/` are official, unmodified Cloudera and Mistral logos (the Cloudera PNG is
resized only). Use them per the owners' guidelines (Mistral: `logos/Mistral_Logos_2026/Mistral_Logo_Guidelines.pdf`):
gradient lockup with white wordmark on dark backgrounds, no recoloring or effects, clearspace of one
symbol height, minimum width 100 px.
